name: 361 Degrees International Limited
summary: 361 Degrees International Limited, an investment holding company, manufactures and trades in sporting goods in the People's Republic of China. It operates through two segments, Adults and Kids. The company offers adult and children footwear, apparel, and accessories for sports and life under the 361 degree core and 361 degree Kids brand names. It also manufactures and trades in shoes soles; trades in children sporting goods; and operates a gas station. In addition, the company engages in the science and technology promotion and application services; research and development of sporting goods; and organizing sports competitions. It operates a network of stores under the 361º core brand name. …
